description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified network domain
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-network-domain --instance-id bastionhost-cn-i7m2btk6g48 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-domain-id 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetNetworkDomain

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。

Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the network domain to query.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的网络域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: network_domain_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to immediately re-check the proxy server status. Valid values:

true: Immediately re-checks the proxy server status and returns the latest ProxyState/ProxyStateErrorCode.

false: Default value. Does not re-check the proxy server status and directly returns the currently recorded status
parameters.help_zh:
是否立即重新检测代理服务器状态。取值：

true：立即重新检测代理服务器状态并返回最新的 ProxyState/ProxyStateErrorCode。

false：默认取值。不重新检测代理服务器状态，直接返回当前记录的状态
parameters.name: check_proxy_state

NetworkDomain.description_en: The details of the network domain

Comment.description_en: The remarks of the network domain

Default.description_en:
Indicates whether the network domain is a built-in network domain.

true: Yes.
false: No
Default.description_zh:
是否为内置网络域。

true：是
false：否

NetworkDomainType.description_en:
The network domain type. Valid values:
Direct: direct connection
Proxy: proxy
NetworkDomainType.description_zh:
网络域类型。取值：
Direct：直连
Proxy：代理

HasPassword.description_en:
Indicates whether a password is set for the proxy server. Valid values:
true: A password is set.
false: No password is set
HasPassword.description_zh:
代理服务器是否设置密码。取值：
true：设置密码
false：未设置密码

NodeType.description_en:
The proxy server node. Valid values:

Master: primary proxy server
Slave: secondary proxy server
NodeType.description_zh:
代理服务器节点。取值：

Master：主代理服务器
Slave：备代理服务器

ProxyState.description_en:
The proxy server status. Valid values:
Available: The proxy server is available.
Unavailable: The proxy server is unavailable
ProxyState.description_zh:
代理服务器状态。
Available：可用
Unavailable：不可用

ProxyStateErrorCode.description_en:
The error code of the proxy server status.

CHECK_PWD_FAILED: The password is incorrect. Password verification failed.
CHECK_PWD_TIMEOUT: Password verification timed out.
CHECK_PWD_NETWORK_ERR: A network error occurred.
UNEXPECTED: An unknown error occurred
ProxyStateErrorCode.description_zh:
代理服务器状态错误码。

CHECK_PWD_FAILED：密码错误，验密失败
CHECK_PWD_TIMEOUT：验密超时
CHECK_PWD_NETWORK_ERR：网络错误
UNEXPECTED：未知错误

ProxyType.description_en:
The proxy method. Valid values:
SSHProxy: SSH proxy
HTTPProxy: HTTP proxy
Socks5Proxy: SOCKS proxy
ProxyType.description_zh:
代理方式。取值：
SSHProxy：SSH代理
HTTPProxy：HTTP代理
Socks5Proxy：Socks代理

User.description_en: The username of the proxy server

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
